name: UIZZE — Stop UI Slop
tagline: Stop Cline from shipping the same generic UI again
description: A free UI finish-gate workflow grounded in UIZZE's catalogue of 800,000+ real web and iOS screens. It forces product-specific design contracts, required interaction states, existing design-system reuse, rendered inspection, and a hard pre-ship review instead of accepting interchangeable card grids and happy-path mockups.
